statements.impact_statement: A truncated host name cannot redirect a request. Most names Python resolves come from configuration (API base URLs, notification and AI endpoints). The URLs users enter (VEX sources by a target's owner, advisory feeds and server lists by an admin) are fetched with httpx, which refuses a URL containing a null byte or any other control character before it connects; the public-host check (backend/app/services/http/public_host.py) may look up the shortened name, but no request follows. User-supplied scan targets are resolved by git, skopeo and the Go scanners after validate_scan_target has checked them, and the sidecar's own lookups go to fixed registry hosts.
